jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The president announces the rule strictly, her face turned three-quarters to the camera. chute: The eager gossip slowly turns her head toward the worried member with a wicked smile. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the worried member's terrified face looking into the camera.

dialogue: Ma sœur, ton billet de dix mille-là est faux dêh !
C'est toi-même qui me l'as donné quand j'ai ramassé !
Laisse dêh, c'est notre membre fondateur.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The treasurer holds the banknote up to the light and accuses her, her face turned three-quarters to the camera. The member leans forward, hands on her hips, and protests. The president says her line calmly without moving, her face clearly visible.
chute: The accusing treasurer slowly lowers the banknote, caught. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the accusing treasurer's caught face looking into the camera.
